Workbench.DirectoryDescription: Inspect registered channel pipelines, endpoint metadata, middleware evidence and message capture.
Workbench.ExceptionsDescription: Inspect retained channel exceptions and lifetime counters, or clear a channel’s retained observable history.
Workbench.LoadingDescription: Reading registered channels, component metadata, and retained observable history.
Workbench.HistoryCleared: Retained observable history for channel {0} was cleared. Lifetime counters remain.

Metadata.CaptureFailed: This value could not be captured.

ClearHistory.Description: Delete the observable records currently retained by this channel.
ClearHistory.Scope: This clears all retained records, including ordinary records and exceptions. The removed evidence cannot be recovered from this history.
ClearHistory.LifetimeHelp: Lifetime counters are preserved. This action does not reinitialize endpoints, recover a channel, or resolve a failure.

Debugger.CaptureScope: Messages are captured before target endpoint dispatch. Captured payloads do not prove downstream receipt.
Debugger.SettingsHelp: Keyword matching is case-insensitive. Settings apply when capture starts; pause capture to change them.
Debugger.DraftHelp: Your edited settings apply on the next Start. The host currently uses keyword {0} and capture depth {1}.

States.NoMessagesDescription: Start capture, then send a matching message or simulate a sample.

Debugger.DetachedSelection: This selected snapshot remains available after its queue entry was trimmed or cleared.
Debugger.NoMetadata: No metadata was captured for this message.
Debugger.CloseHelp: Closing this inspector stops its polling. Host capture continues until Stop capture is selected, including capture used by another inspector.

Messages.ReadFailed: The latest queue read failed: {0}. Previous captured messages remain visible.

Design.BlueprintDisabledOwner: Owner role is not eligible in this host.
Design.BlueprintUndeclared: Channel identities become available after the first explicit start (manual held).

Debugger.SampleNotCaptured: The current capture settings did not retain the simulated sample.
Debugger.SampleScope: Simulated samples go only to the debugger's capture queue.

Design.DebuggerUnavailable: The selected message debugger is unavailable.
Design.DirAttentionLabel: Channels needing attention (unavailable, blocked, or retaining exceptions)
Design.DirUnifiedDesc: Manage setup lifecycles inline beside each pipeline's endpoints, middleware, and exception pool.
Design.EmptyBody: No channel setups or pipelines are registered in this host yet. Register a setup to inspect local initialization and exception evidence.
Design.ExAttentionLabel: Exceptions currently retained in bounded observable history
Design.ExHorizonDesc: Left track compares retained exceptions against each channel's shared history capacity; right track contrasts solid retained records against hatched trimmed or cleared lifetime exceptions.
Design.ExHorizonEmpty: No channels currently hold retained or lifetime exceptions.
Design.ExHorizonReadout: {0}: {1} retained / {2} shared cap · {3} lifetime ({4} no longer retained) · latest {5}
Design.ExHorizonReadoutIdle: Focus or click any channel lane to open its frozen exception details and stack trace.
Design.ExLedgerDesc: Compare each channel's exact pipeline identity, local runtime state, retained count, lifetime counter, and shared history capacity.
Design.ExScopeNote: History capacity is shared by ordinary records and exceptions. A channel with no retained exceptions may still hold ordinary records; clearing history removes both while leaving lifetime counters intact.
Design.ExSearchPlaceholder: Channel ID, group, pipeline ID, or exception message

Facts.SetupReady: No held, failed, or disabled setups

Findings.Blocked: Kafka partition {1} on {0} is blocked at offset {2}.
Findings.Calm: None of the {0} registered channels has an attention signal. {1} channel setups are running.
Findings.ExCalm: None of the {0} registered channels retains exceptions, and the lifetime total is zero.
Findings.ExCalmHistorical: None of the {0} registered channels retains exceptions. All {1} lifetime exceptions have left the shared pool.
Findings.ExPeak: {0} holds the largest retained share ({1} of {2} shared slots, latest {3}).
Findings.ExRetained: {0} of {1} channels retain {2} exceptions ({3} lifetime total).
Findings.Held: {0} manual setup(s) ({1}) remain held with undeclared channels until first explicit start.
Findings.Provenance: Source component provenance is not recorded by the tracker.
Findings.Retaining: {0} channels hold {1} retained exceptions ({2} lifetime across host). {3} holds the most.

Design.LoadFailedBody: No complete management capture is available. Check host reachability and click Refresh to try again.
Design.MissingChannelBody: The exact channel identity in the URL is absent from this capture. Show all channels to choose an available registration.
Design.MissingChannelTitle: The selected channel is not registered
Design.NoMatchesBody: Adjust the search, group, initialization state, or exception filter to compare other registered channels.
Design.OverlapNote: A channel may carry multiple reasons; reason counts do not sum to the headline.
Design.ScopeNote: Initialization describes local endpoint setup. It does not prove remote transport availability or successful message delivery. Retained exceptions and lifetime counts are an independent bounded evidence axis.
Design.SearchPlaceholder: Channel ID, setup, group, endpoint or middleware

Sheet.DirectionUnknownHelp: The configured endpoints and transform order are shown below. The endpoint did not report a transport direction.
Sheet.EndpointConfigHelp: These entries configure endpoints separately from the per-message transform sequence.
Sheet.ExCaptureWarningTitle: Some exception evidence could not be captured
Sheet.ExEmptyClean: This capture has 0 retained and 0 lifetime exceptions.
Sheet.ExEmptyWithLifetime: 0 exceptions are currently retained; {0} lifetime exceptions were previously recorded and have been trimmed or cleared.
Sheet.ExNoMatch: No retained exception records match this filter.
Sheet.ExSearchPlaceholder: Filter by exception type, message, or context
Sheet.ExSubsetHelp: Retained counts cover the full current history pool. The list below shows the requested most recent subset (default 10); lifetime counters include exceptions that were trimmed or cleared.
Sheet.FrozenNote: Captured {0} · shows the detached evidence from when it opened
Sheet.KafkaBlockedHelp: Partition consumption halted after exhausting retries so failed records are not silently skipped. Fix the underlying cause, then reinitialize to resume from committed offsets.
Sheet.KafkaTitle: Kafka input failure policy & consumer counts
Sheet.MwEmpty: No middleware is registered for this channel.
Sheet.MwTableHelp: Configuration entries appear first, followed by transforms in execution order. Live row actions resolve the exact registered component separately from this frozen capture.
Sheet.NoEndpointConfig: No endpoint configuration middleware is registered.
Sheet.NoTransforms: No transform middleware. Messages dispatch directly to the opposite endpoint.
Sheet.RecordsFailed: Retained exception details could not be captured
Sheet.SequenceUnavailable: Record #{0} is outside the current retained results.
Sheet.SpineHelpBidi: Bidirectional pipeline: both inner and outer sources execute the transform sequence below in the same 1 → N order (never reversed for outer ingress) before dispatching to the opposite endpoint.
Sheet.SpineHelpInput: Messages enter from the outer endpoint, pass top-to-bottom through each transform below, and dispatch to the inner endpoint. Select any node to inspect.
Sheet.SpineHelpOutput: Messages originate from the inner endpoint, pass top-to-bottom through each transform below, and dispatch to the outer endpoint. Select any node to inspect.
Sheet.SpineSameOrderPill: Same order both ways · runs 1 → N, never reversed
Sheet.UnavailableHelp: The local endpoints are currently unavailable.
Sheet.UnknownBody: The channel identity "{0}" is absent from this capture. Its setup may be held or stopped, or the identifier changed.

Design.StaleNote: The previous complete capture from {0} remains visible; its timestamp has not advanced. Refresh to retry.
